OVERVIEW
Discover the benefits of Azure OpenAI
Foundational, multimodal, and reasoning models
Instantly access cutting-edge foundational models and powerful reasoning models from OpenAI. Accelerate your AI innovation journey by rapidly deploying models optimized for complex problem-solving, logical reasoning, and multimodal capabilities including real-time audio.
Learn more
Integrated AI agents
Advanced model customization
Trustworthy AI with Azure
USE CASES
Apply Azure OpenAI to a variety of use cases
Intelligent contact centers
Automate customer support, summarize conversations, and provide real-time coaching for agents, reducing post-call efforts by up to 50%.
Learn more
Content generation
Create personalized marketing content, automate product descriptions, and power digital art creation using models like GPT-4 and DALL·E.
Learn more
Data-driven insights
Analyze proprietary data for smarter decision-making, enhancing workflows in finance, healthcare, and retail.
Learn more
Workflow automation
Automate routine tasks to optimize operations and supply chains with Azure OpenAI’s custom models.
Learn more
Accessibility
Create equal opportunities and improvements to quality of life across diverse communities with assistive solutions such as real-time.
Learn more
SECURITY
Embedded security and compliance
34,000
Full-time equivalent engineers dedicated to security initiatives at Microsoft.
Learn more
15,000
Partners with specialized security expertise.
 
Learn more
>100
Compliance certifications, including over 50 specific to global regions and countries.
Learn more
Learn more about security on Azure
Pricing
Flexible Azure OpenAI deployment types and pricing
Discover three flexible deployment strategies—Standard, Provisioned, and Batch—to tailor your plan to your business needs, whether that includes small-scale experiments or deploying large, high-performance workloads.
See Azure OpenAI pricing
